speaker: Court Reporter
text: We are on the record. This is the deposition of Witness B, a fictional witness, taken in the matter of Case 2026-DEMO.

speaker: Attorney Reyes
text: Please state your name for the record and confirm you understand you are under oath.

speaker: Witness B
text: Witness B. Yes, I understand I am under oath.

speaker: Attorney Reyes
text: Where were you at approximately 6:45 on the morning of the collision?

speaker: Witness B
text: I was waiting for the early bus, over on the corner near the crossing. I had a good view of everything from where I was standing.

speaker: Attorney Reyes
text: I am handing you Exhibit 4, an overhead map of the intersection. Can you mark where you were standing?

speaker: Witness B
text: Sure. I was about here, a little way back from the corner, roughly in this area.

exhibit.note: Witness B marks her position with a red X

speaker: Attorney Reyes
text: Let the record reflect the witness has marked Exhibit 4. What did you see of the signal?

speaker: Witness B
text: The light was red for the northbound truck. I am certain of that. I saw it clearly.

speaker: Attorney Reyes
text: Was there anything between you and the signal?

speaker: Witness B
text: No, nothing that I recall. It was early and fairly quiet.

speaker: Attorney Reyes
text: Thank you. No further questions at this time.
